entries.title: Theme admin list showing healthcare.
entries.notes: Capture with only the core Capell stack, Foundation Theme, Layout Builder, and capell-app/theme-healthcare installed in the isolated demo harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator confirms the healthcare theme is available through the core Themes resource without installing another theme package.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with healthcare theme.
entries.notes: Capture a seeded clinic page after installing capell-app/theme-healthcare and building the Foundation Theme/frontend assets.
entries.useCase: A visitor sees a seeded appointment-led page rendered through the healthcare utility bar, navigation, hero, service finder, services, clinicians, booking, events, proof, comparison, resources, contact, CTA, and footer sections.

entries.title: Healthcare homepage desktop.
entries.notes: Capture the desktop healthcare homepage with appointment hero, service finder, clinician proof, booking CTA, and footer.
entries.useCase: A clinic owner reviews the first viewport and conversion flow on desktop before activating the theme.

entries.title: Healthcare homepage mobile.
entries.notes: Capture the mobile healthcare homepage with compact navigation, appointment CTA, service cards, and footer.
entries.useCase: A clinic owner verifies the mobile patient journey and tap targets before activating the theme.

entries.title: Healthcare services listing.
entries.notes: Capture a seeded services listing with finder controls, service cards, and booking prompts.
entries.useCase: A patient browses care options and moves toward the right enquiry path.

entries.title: Healthcare clinician detail.
entries.notes: Capture a seeded clinician or care article detail page with image-led hero, body copy, proof, and related services.
entries.useCase: A patient reviews clinician expertise and available next steps.

entries.title: Healthcare contact page.
entries.notes: Capture the healthcare contact surface with locations, enquiry panel, and clear appointment actions.
entries.useCase: A patient finds the right contact route after browsing services.

entries.title: Theme preview URL output.
entries.notes: Capture a signed preview URL generated with CreateThemePreviewUrlAction for the seeded healthcare theme, site, and page.
entries.useCase: An administrator opens a signed preview URL to inspect a page with the healthcare theme applied before publishing the theme choice.
